scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model” (preprints/A-PD4-group-without-an-aspherical-manifold-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ccbbf7f15686b6f7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 1-2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a finitely presented group G with a finite, oriented, four-dimensional aspherical Poincaré complex Q such that Hi (G; ZG) = 0 (i ̸= 4), H4 (G; ZG) ∼ = Z 1 with trivial right G-action on the last group, but no closed aspherical topological four-manifold has fundamental group G. In particular the trivial left ZG-module Z has a finite resolution by finitely generated free modules.
